instruction: How many venmo friends have I made since the start of March this year?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes, only an integer answer. The agent lists all Venmo friends (search_friends with no query, paginated) and counts those whose friendship started on/after 2023-03-01 (current date 2023-05-18, 'this' March). Pagination is modeled with two page constants (page-0, page-1) matching the 5-call reference solution; each search_friends call tallies its page into the single count object, and complete_task requires both pages tallied into the answer object before finishing. Credentials: passwords via supervisor.show_account_passwords, venmo login with supervisor email, token from venmo.login. complete_task is structurally last (all other actions require (not (task-completed))).
